outcome: Ratio of peak early diastolic flow velocity (E) to peak early diastolic annular velocity (e') (E/e')
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with higher right ventricular E/e' (a measure of diastolic function) on the second day after birth, but this difference did not persist.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with higher right ventricular E/e' (a measure of diastolic function) on the second day after birth, but this difference did not persist.
